name: Beef rolled with enoki
summary: Bò cuộn kim châm is beef rolled with enoki, one of the town grills. The page names the roll and does not describe a sauce.
origin: Named on the national desk’s list of Sa Pa grills.
howToEat: At the grill stalls. A sauce was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Hồ Sa Pa and the road down to the market, in cold weather. The hour is check on arrival.
seoTitle: Beef and enoki in Sapa — a town grill
seoDescription: Bò cuộn kim châm on the Sa Pa grill list, at the lake and on the road down to the market. Check on arrival.
